Manual.label: Manual Journal Entry
Manual.description: Free-form journal entry posted directly in the General Ledger. Any account may be used — no module-specific validation is applied.

Allocation.label: Ledger Allocation
Allocation.description: Cost or revenue allocation across financial dimensions or accounts using ledger allocation rules — overhead spreading, shared services recharge.

Periodic.label: Periodic Journal
Periodic.description: Recurring accruals and deferrals — prepayments, accrued expenses, accrued income. Typically reversed at period start.

Intercompany.label: Intercompany Transaction
Intercompany.description: Cross-entity posting — intercompany receivable (due from) debited in one entity, intercompany payable (due to) credited in the counterpart entity.
